title: Change the storage location of your number plates
summary: You can apply to move your stored number plates from one service centre location to another.
intro:
If you have stored your number plates at a service centre and wish to change the location, you can apply to have them moved to another service centre.

A 'move number plates' fee will apply.

Please call 13 77 88 or visit a service centre to arrange this.

Note: An auxiliary number plate must be stored with its associated number plates and cannot be moved to a separate service centre location.
who_can_apply: You must have stored your number plates at a service centre and wish to change the location.

internal_links.text: Collect or surrender number plates held in storage
Place your number plates on hold/in storage
Renew the storage/hold period of number plates

faqs.q: What must I do to move my number plates?
faqs.a: You must apply to have your number plates moved to another service centre. A 'move number plates' fee will apply.

faqs.q: How can I arrange to move my number plates?
faqs.a: You can call 13 77 88 or visit a service centre to arrange this.

faqs.q: Can I move an auxiliary number plate?
faqs.a: No, an auxiliary number plate must be stored with its associated number plates and cannot be moved to a separate service centre location.
